definition.en: The Union Budget on Agriculture refers to the annual financial statement and policy framework presented by the Government of India, detailing the allocation of funds and strategic priorities for the development of the agricultural sector.
definition.hi: The Union Budget on Agriculture refers to the annual financial statement and policy framework presented by the Government of India, detailing the allocation of funds and strategic priorities for the development of the agricultural sector.

importanceInUpsc.en: This topic is crucial for UPSC GS-3 as it reflects the government's fiscal commitment to food security, rural development, and farmer welfare. Understanding budget trends helps candidates analyze policy shifts, subsidy rationalization, and the impact of public investment on agricultural productivity.

learningOutcomes.en: Analyze the shift in budgetary focus from production-centric to income-centric agricultural policies.

learningOutcomes.en: Evaluate the impact of fiscal allocations on rural infrastructure and agricultural credit.
